rationale: NVDA gapped down 7.27% and is currently trading below both VWAP ($176.41) and the 9-EMA ($176.78), with the last five 1-minute candles showing a consistent drift lower from ~176 to ~175, suggesting continued selling pressure. However, the broader market is strongly up (SPY +1.96%, VIXY -9.75%), creating a conflicting signal — the stock is underperforming significantly relative to the tape, which makes both a long (fighting the downtrend) and a short (fighting the market tailwind) risky. With the price sitting mid-range (45.7%) and no clear structural level to anchor a high-conviction entry, the risk/reward is insufficient to commit capital given the already negative P&L today.
